We need to determine charges. Primary charge: 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票. In this case, they used fake VAT invoices to deduct tax, i.e., 虚开增值税专用发票, and used for抵扣税款发票. Not export refund. So include 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票? The label includes both export refund and deduction. The case only involves deduction, but the label is combined. In examples, they used that combined label for cases of virtual invoices for deduction and export refund. So we should include that label.

Companion charges: economic crime (经济犯) co-occurred 1x, tax evasion (逃税) 1x, concealment/destruction of accounting records (隐匿、故意销毁会计凭证、会计帐簿、财务会计报告) 1x. Need to include each ONLY if facts support it.

Check facts: The defendant used fake invoices to deduct tax, which is tax evasion (逃税) because they evaded tax. Indeed they evaded tax of 77517.1. So include 逃税.

Economic crime? The primary charge is economic crime. The term 经济犯 likely refers to crimes of economic nature. The case is about tax fraud, which is economic crime. So include 经济犯.

Concealment of accounting records? No mention of destroying or concealing accounting documents. They have invoices, tax returns, etc. No mention of concealment. So not include.

Thus final answer: include primary charge and companion charges 经济犯 and 逃税.

Label for primary: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". Use exactly that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯;逃税<eoa>
